studies.title: Measuring the Earth from a mountain
studies.caption: Al-Biruni climbs a hill above the Punjab plain, measures the dip of the horizon and works out the Earth's radius.
studies.prompt: Side view of a scholar at Nandana hilltop in1025CE carefully sighting a small angular measuring instrument toward a distant level plain and hazy horizon. Rock ledge and sparse notebook nearby, no telescope or modern theodolite; landscape dominates, gesture is precise.
